market_summary: US small caps closed Aug 29 with a split tape: IWM 299.81, IJR 146.78, VB 304.28 all fractionally lower after a 22.7% YTD record run, while flows tell the rotation story — IWM +$733M on Aug 27 as QQQ bled $4.55B. Russell 2000 sits 12 points under its 3,069.71 ATH with monthly RSI 70.8 and StochRSI 89.4, technically intact but overbought.

top_story.headline: Russell 2000 Closes at Record 3,068, Up 22.7% YTD — Now +9.5 pp Ahead of S&P 500 as September Hike Odds Collapse
top_story.why_it_matters: The record 27 closes this year is a rates trade, not an earnings trade: with small caps carrying more floating-rate debt, every 25 bps of Fed pricing is ~2% of Russell operating earnings (BofA). The CPI/PPI cool-down that drove September hike odds from ~58% post-FOMC to ~30s is the single variable repricing the most rate-sensitive index.

themes.title: Flows Confirm Rotation — But It's Mechanical
themes.synthesis: $334B of June reconstitution buying plus Aug 27's $733M IWM inflow vs QQQ $4.55B outflow shows broadening beyond AI megacaps, yet earnings are lagging the price; Russell strength is flow + multiple, not profit growth yet.

themes.title: Overbought But Not Broken — Citi Crowding Warning
themes.synthesis: Monthly StochRSI 89.4 and RSI 70.8 are rare; history says >85 on monthly StochRSI precedes 10–15% corrections in 2–3 months, and Citi flags long exposure extended with short covering exhausted and weekly flow momentum fading.

themes.title: September 11 CPI Is the Fuse
themes.synthesis: Cleveland Fed nowcasts 0.38% MoM for August CPI — the first print with post-ceasefire oil — so the same rate relief that lifted IWM 8.6% in two weeks versus SPX 1.6% can reverse fastest in small caps if the print is hot.

outlook: Watch August CPI (Sep 11), FOMC minutes depth on the triple dissent, and payrolls Sep 4 — if inflation stays tame and no hike, broadening extends; if retail –0.6% and negative payrolls resume, small caps give back beta fastest.
